Home.faq1Answer: A project bootstrap pack: readable specifications, agent guidance, relevant skills, and an ordered backlog based on your project context.
Home.faq2Question: Does it write my application code?
Home.faq2Answer: No. BantuinCoding prepares the context and documentation your coding agent needs. You use the pack with the agent you choose.

ProviderDesk.caption: BYOK checkpoint
ProviderDesk.title: Wire the model without leaking the key.
ProviderDesk.subtitle: This screen only configures the current server session. Provider secrets do not belong in generated Markdown, browser-visible errors, fixtures, telemetry, or ZIP exports.
ProviderDesk.setupTest: Test the connection with your key.
ProviderDesk.setupSave: Save the profile for future sessions.
ProviderDesk.aiProviderDesc: Choose a provider, confirm the model ID, and test the connection before running analysis or document generation.
ProviderDesk.securityNoteDesc: Responses expose safe provider/model metadata only. If a provider rejects the key, the UI shows an actionable typed failure without printing the raw SDK payload.
ProviderDesk.byokGuideSubtitle: Everything you need to know about keys, models, and security before generating your first pack.
ProviderDesk.cardByokDesc: Bring Your Own Key means you pay your AI provider directly for exact tokens used. We never charge monthly markups or sell AI credits.
ProviderDesk.cardProviderDesc: Anthropic Claude excels at deep requirements, OpenAI GPT at code structure, Gemini at massive context, and OpenRouter at aggregation.
ProviderDesk.cardSecurityDesc: Keys remain in your encrypted server session. They never leak into project briefs, generated Markdown, telemetry, or export archives.
ProviderDesk.readinessPrereqDesc: An active provider key is required before running the requirement analysis or generating documentation packs.
ProviderDesk.readinessNextDesc: Once your key tests successfully, proceed to idea capture. BantuinCoding will interview you and produce complete agent-ready specifications.
ProviderDesk.faq1Q: Where do I find my API key?
ProviderDesk.faq1A: Create an account on your provider's developer console (console.anthropic.com, platform.openai.com, aistudio.google.com, or openrouter.ai), generate a secret key, and paste it into the vault below.
ProviderDesk.faq2Q: Why should I test the connection?
ProviderDesk.faq2A: Testing confirms your API key has valid billing/quota and can reach the provider before you begin project generation.
ProviderDesk.faq3Q: Can I switch models or keys later?
ProviderDesk.faq3A: Yes. You can save multiple key profiles in your local vault, switch active profiles with one click, or delete them anytime.
